title: hibiscus gourmania
intro: Hibiscus gourmania, commonly known as the "Red Sorrel" or "Hibiscus sabdariffa," is a tropical plant native to Africa and Asia, characterized by its distinctive red flowers and edible calyces. The plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Hibiscus gourmania include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also include analgesic and anti-anxiety effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for digestive issues, skin problems, and stress relief.
